title: Zephyr: Packet Too Big
close_reason: Implemented RFC 4443 Packet Too Big construction with authenticated invoking-packet validation, extension-header inspection, error/Redirect/non-unique-source/congestion suppression, PTB multicast and link multicast/broadcast exceptions, exact code/MTU/checksum wire output, 1280-byte IPv6 minimum-MTU quote cap, and no-partial-output invalid/boundary handling. Added canonical shared-vector, suppression, malformed, maximum-quote, standalone C, and Zephyr tests. Green: qemu_x86 28/28, strict standalone C, clang-tidy, cppcheck, Python ICMPv6/vector parity 6/6, Rust PTB parity 3/3, Rust no_std check.
